value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Tot Gym drop-in for 18 months-3.11 yrs, Thursdays 9:30-12, fall session Sept 10-Dec 16, $15/visit, no pre-registration - their site says. They also run a Preschool/Kinderfun drop-in but don't post its price. Want me to confirm details before you go?
